drafted_from: workflow:run-one-drawn-gauntlet-case's own file, tools/workflows/recipes/run-one-drawn-gauntlet-case.json (its condition, wake and three steps), and the e2e skill's generated cases: axes, formulas, cases and results as tables in the person's own database, drawn by the formula engine and run by the workflow engine
start_here: Say to your AI: "Turn on workflow:run-one-drawn-gauntlet-case's wake chosen--a-gauntlet-case-row-is-added, attach record_row_change() to gauntlet_example_cases, and add case 59 with call {\"address\": \"https://127.0.0.1/mcp\", \"runs_here\": false}." The workflow then reads that row, makes the list call it stands for, and writes the answer to gauntlet_example_results under k 59.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing in lists: the cases it reads and the results it writes are tables in the person's own database, reached in SQL with tool:run-sql-in-my-database, and their names come from the change that woke it.
instructions: 1. Keep the gauntlet's tables in the person's own database: gauntlet_<name>_axes (one row per axis: domain, extremes, strange values, and `calls`, the list input each value stands for), gauntlet_<name>_cases (k bigint primary key, words jsonb, call jsonb, drawn_by text) and gauntlet_<name>_results (k bigint primary key, answered jsonb, run_by text).

2. Draw the cases with the formula engine: the size formula (flat_map each axis to its value count, then op:core.product) and the draw formula (case k as one value per axis, index floor(k / stride) mod radix); keep both as rows of gauntlet_<name>_formulas.

3. Attach record_row_change() to gauntlet_<name>_cases (CREATE TRIGGER gauntlet_<name>_cases_changes AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON gauntlet_<name>_cases FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION record_row_change()), with the noticer's keep-noticing-row-changes and route-each-row-change's a-row-changed on.
4. Turn on this workflow's wake chosen--a-gauntlet-case-row-is-added, then insert the drawn cases as rows of gauntlet_<name>_cases.

5. Read gauntlet_<name>_results: one row per case, the whole answer of its call (or {error} when the door refused the call). A split is a result the gauntlet's property does not hold for; read it in SQL and keep each one as a row.

worked_examples.title: A case naming a private address is listed and refused, and its answer is kept
worked_examples.ask: Run the drawn case 59 of my example gauntlet.

fact.condition: a gauntlet case row is added

worked_examples.given: read-the-case read the row at position 77: {"k": 59, "words": ["a call naming no credential", "a private address"], "call": {"address": "https://127.0.0.1/mcp", "runs_here": false}}; list asked tools:list with that call.
worked_examples.hands_back: One row of gauntlet_example_results: k 59, answered {"tools": [], "next": null, "unavailable": [{"source": "127.0.0.1", "unreachable": "The server did not answer: The address must be a public site, not this computer or a private network."}]}, run_by "workflow:run-one-drawn-gauntlet-case".
